## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender woman with a milk-white, freckled complexion, luminous gray eyes that appear green in some lights, and thick hair that darkened from plain red in her youth to a rich auburn. She has a broad forehead, a pronounced pointed chin, a shapely nose, and an expressive mouth that curves into a sweet smile. Her face is constantly illuminated by her ever-varying emotions and vivid imagination.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c15 P14](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0014), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c33 P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012), [v2 c19 P41](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0041), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v4 c5 P13](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0013)_

## Personality

Anne is an intensely imaginative, passionate, and romantic individual who experiences life's joys and sorrows with heightened intensity. She is fiercely loyal, generous, and affectionate toward her friends, possessing a natural warmth that wins over people of all ages. Though she can be impulsive, quick-tempered, and stubborn when her pride or sense of justice is stirred, she is deeply conscientious, introspective, and quick to repent her mistakes. She finds profound joy in the beauty of nature, poetry, and kindred spirits, maintaining a youthful enthusiasm and optimism even amid heartbreak and disappointment.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P5](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0005), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c15 P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c31 P5](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0005), [v2 c7 P17](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0017), [v2 c12 P40](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0040), [v3 c14 P29](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0029), [v4 c8 P11](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0011)_

## History

Anne Shirley arrived at Green Gables in Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, due to a mistake when Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert sent for an orphan boy. Though Marilla initially intended to send her back, Matthew's fond desire and Anne's passionate plea won her a home at Green Gables. She quickly made a bosom friend in Diana Barry, but her early years in Avonlea were filled with misadventures—losing her temper at Mrs. Rachel Lynde, accidentally intoxicating Diana with currant wine, dyeing her hair green, and breaking her slate over Gilbert Blythe's head when he called her 'Carrots.' After a rivalry in school, Anne attended Queen's Academy, winning the Avery Scholarship. Upon Matthew's sudden death, she gave up college to stay at Green Gables with Marilla and taught the Avonlea school for two years, during which she founded the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and helped care for the orphaned Keith twins, Davy and Dora. After Mrs. Lynde moved in with Marilla, Anne attended Redmond College in Kingsport, graduating with High Honors in English. During college she refused proposals from Billy Andrews, Charlie Sloane, and the wealthy Roy Gardner, eventually realizing her deep love for her longtime rival and friend, Gilbert Blythe. After teaching three years as principal of Summerside High School, she married Gilbert in the Green Gables orchard and moved to a little 'house of dreams' in Four Winds Harbor. There she suffered the tragic loss of her firstborn baby, Joyce, before giving birth to a healthy son, James Matthew.

## Background by volume

- Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to High School teachers Walter and Bertha Shirley, who both died of fever when she was three months old  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Brought up by hand by Mrs. Thomas until age eight, looking after the Thomas children  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived with Mrs. Hammond for over two years, caring for three pairs of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Spent four months in an orphan asylum at Hopeton before being sent to Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Adopted by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Green Gables at age eleven  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c5 P10](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0010), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005)</sub>
